customer.business: konforme-ki.de (German AI inference & compliance platform for professional secrecy holders)
customer.target: German lawyers, tax advisors, medical practitioners, and notaries (§ 203 StGB) handling confidential client/patient data

behaviours.name: Risk-Averse Generalist
behaviours.how: Consults the regional bar/chamber (Rechtsanwaltskammer / Steuerberaterkammer) before adopting any new software.

behaviours.name: Efficiency Seeker
behaviours.how: Wants to use LLMs for contract drafting, document analysis, and patient summary prep, but blocked by data privacy fears.

behaviours.name: Tech-Savvy Innovator
behaviours.how: Already tried ChatGPT or Claude but stopped due to GDPR and § 203 StGB criminal liability concerns.

behaviours.name: Compliance Skeptic
behaviours.how: Distrusts tech startups claiming legal compliance without signed contractual guarantees and verifiable audit trails.

objections: Does a signed contract from a small GmbH protect me against a criminal probe under § 203 StGB?
Why not just use Microsoft Copilot / Azure OpenAI with enterprise agreements?
Is €290/month too high when OpenAI API tokens cost pennies?
How do I know data is not routed through US-owned cloud infrastructure?
Will using AI violate my professional liability insurance (Berufshaftpflicht)?
I don't have time to configure custom API endpoints or Python code.
habits: you read legal trade journals (BRAK-Mitteilungen, DStR) and industry newsletters
you are extremely protective of client confidentiality and client trust
you bill by the hour or case and value time-saving tools that reduce admin load
you rely on established software vendors (Lexoffice, RA-MICRO, DATEV) rather than startups

pitch:
konforme-ki.de provides AI inference hosted on dedicated hardware in Nürnberg, Germany, with a signed § 203 StGB confidentiality agreement (Verschwiegenheitsvereinbarung) and cryptographically hash-chained audit trails.
Designed specifically for lawyers, tax advisors, notaries, and medical professionals handling confidential client and patient data.
Pricing: Free tier with 5 million tokens per month; €290 per month for the full § 203 compliance subscription including signed Anlage 1 and audit records.
Get started instantly at konforme-ki.de with a 60-second compliance check and free API key issuance.
